description: Before you start a new processing activity, check whether the law requires a DPIA first (GDPR Art 35 / DPDP §10 / LGPD Art 38). Give the purpose + data categories (and scale / systematic-monitoring / automated-decision / cross-border / vulnerable-subjects flags); returns dpia_required + the 9-criterion WP29 analysis + jurisdiction guidance, so you know whether to pause and assess before proceeding.
name: dpia_threshold_check
